card.name: Per or slash after a unit
card.fires_on: The word per, a slash, or similar link right after a measure such as mL, km, mg or cm, where a rate or ratio comes next (mL per day, mg/m2). It also fires on unit words inside dose expressions.

modes.label: Per after a measure
modes.description: The word per or in follows a unit and begins a rate or size phrase.
modes.example: mL<< per>> day. The recommended volume of Multrys

modes.label: Slash in dose ratios
modes.description: A slash after mg or ng starts the denominator such as m2 or mL.

modes.label: Unit word in dose phrase
modes.description: The word unit or Units inside a dose statement, before a slash or the word dose.
modes.example: Recommended total dose 3 Units/kg to 6<< Units>>/kg (maximum 200 Units

card.writes: It lowers the odds of per and similar rate words, and raises unit-like tokens such as lux and litres.
card.plain: It marks the spot right after a measurement where a rate such as per day or per m2 is about to be written.
